title: DISTANCE UNKNOWN
synopsis: 50 years after the Vietnam War, wounds still exist for both the domestic and diasporic communities. Two young filmmakers from Hanoi travel to Orange County, California, where many Vietnamese war refugees resettled in the 1980s. They ask three men of different generations, unknown to one another, to reflect on their Vietnamese identities and the war’s legacy.
availability: The film is currently in post-production and is scheduled to release in Winter 2026. A rough cut of the first 40 minutes can be available upon request. Please Press Gallery for pitch deck.
